api_notes: unique_finest is sample target convention, never hidden architecture
empty binary meet is one block
cheap certificate: validate must-link forest AND direct feasibility of its component partition
adaptive: current meet is upper equivalence bound, NOT forced ownership
separator may regroup current blocks; must only split at least one current block
no-separator proof covers ALL canonical compatible-candidate masks satisfying split predicate, plus justified graph omissions
infeasible intermediate meet of valid separators already certifies multiple maximal exist
at most m-1 successful refinements, no polynomial oracle-time guarantee
partial search generally cannot assert finest; no frontier/kmax enumeration claim
